entries.5b333c1fce9908b4: The corporate group consists of the company and three [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], and has three [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. The core is the 'Building Materials Related Business', under which the company co-develops with leading manufacturers around the world, imports architectural finishing materials for floors and walls centered on tiles and stone, water-related products such as faucets, and housing equipment such as system kitchens, and sells them directly to building owners, builders and construction companies in Japan. In addition, there is the 'Real Estate Leasing Business', which leases the group's head office building, distribution centers and company housing, and 'Other', which provides logistics management handling the receipt and shipment of goods; most of the former's revenue comes from leasing within the group, and all of the latter's revenue comes from transactions within the group. Of consolidated revenue of ¥17,036 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers in the Building Materials Related Business accounted for ¥16,885 million.

entries.70c9e7c83434bd68: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,232 million (down 29.1% year on year, a decrease of ¥918 million). The annual securities report states that, in addition to the decline in revenue, the effects included higher purchase costs due to resource prices and a weaker yen, and losses on disposal of inventories recorded as the company advanced inventory soundness measures. Segment operating profit was ¥2,456 million for the Building Materials Related Business (down 24.2% year on year), ¥1,268 million for the Real Estate Leasing Business (down 4.3%) and ¥378 million for Other (down 11.9%); as these figures are before adjustments such as corporate expenses, the total is larger than consolidated operating profit. Ordinary profit was ¥12,126 million (up 38.4% year on year) and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥8,063 million (up 34.1%), greatly exceeding operating profit. This is because the company enters into foreign exchange contracts since product settlements carry exchange rate risk, and as the yen weakened further at year-end, it recorded a gain on valuation of foreign exchange contracts of ¥6,739 million (prior year: ¥2,441 million) as non-operating income. The balance of the gain on valuation of foreign exchange contracts rose from ¥14,292 million at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2025 to ¥21,032 million at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026. The annual securities report states that this valuation gain or loss changes significantly depending on year-end exchange rates and greatly affects ordinary profit and net income, and it therefore treats operating profit as the key indicator.

entries.7f0d18e2bb9c0d79: A business that imports architectural finishing materials, centered on tiles and stone, used for floors and walls of stores, commercial facilities, houses and condominiums, co-developed with the world's top manufacturers, and sells them directly to domestic building owners, builders, construction companies and others; it is the core of the Group. It also imports and sells plumbing products such as faucets and housing equipment such as system kitchens in the same way, and undertakes construction work that uses these products as materials. Selling prices are clearly stated in catalogs and on the website and are the same regardless of the purchaser's attributes. Showrooms are located in five places: Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka and Okinawa. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,885 million (down 8.2% from the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥2,456 million (down 24.2% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for almost all of consolidated revenue of ¥17,036 million. The securities report cites persistently high purchasing costs and, owing to a shortage of skilled workers at construction sites, construction delays and postponed starts on some large projects as the reasons.

entries.813602249200cd53: The company has long-standing transactions with about 350 leading manufacturers worldwide and imports and handles products co-developed with those manufacturers. In addition to tiles and stone, the company handles water-related products such as faucets and housing equipment such as system kitchens; in July 2024 it absorbed Advantec Co., Ltd., which manufactures, sells and installs unit baths, through an absorption merger, and is working to build a structure for proposing architectural finishing materials, housing equipment and unit baths together. Part of the processing of products is outsourced to the subsidiary ADVAN LOGISTICS CO., LTD., and some products are sold to the subsidiary Yamako Co., Ltd. Imported products are stored at the company's own distribution centers in three locations (Ibaraki, Mie and Fukuoka) and delivered nationwide. Merchandise purchases for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,283 million. Most purchases are from overseas manufacturers, centered on Europe and Asia, and are settled in foreign currencies, mainly U.S. dollars.
